title: Citigroup bets on Meta's Muse as AI's 'front door to the internet'
key_facts: Citigroup estimates Meta's AI assistant Muse could generate more than $27 billion in annual revenue by 2030.
Citi calls Muse increasingly a 'front door to the internet', helping users search, compare and transact online.
Muse has had more than 6.6 million cumulative downloads and 1.8 million daily active users since launch.
Forecast: about $23 billion annual transaction-related revenue and about $4.5 billion from subscriptions by 2030.
Muse debuted on 8 Sep 2026 and faces competition from ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude.
Meta shares are up 12.4% this year and more than 20% since Muse debuted.
quote_evidence: Citigroup estimates Meta's AI assistant Muse could generate more than $27 billion in annual revenue by 2030, as growing adoption strengthens its position in the emerging personal agent market.

Citi said Muse has recorded more than 6.6 million cumulative downloads since its launch, while daily active users have reached 1.8 million as new use cases emerge and Meta increases efforts to promote the service.
why_it_matters_hint: Citi forecasts $27bn a year for Muse by 2030 from early usage.
